scenario: `s !~ /pattern/` fires when the string does NOT match per LREG.1.3. Assert two users: `admin_alice` (matches /^admin/ so does NOT fire) and `bob` (doesn't match so fires). One fire.
rules_ds:
schema User scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    name: String mutable

rule non_admin:
    User u where u.name !~ /^admin/
->
    log info "non-admin user"
